nodes.name: colors.xml
nodes.summary: Defines the Android application color resources for the burgundy primary and accent, paper background, dark ink, and gold brand palette.
nodes.languageNotes: Android XML resource names provide stable references consumed by themes and native surfaces.

nodes.name: ic_launcher_background.xml
nodes.summary: Defines the paper-colored background resource used by the adaptive Android launcher icon.

nodes.name: strings.xml
nodes.summary: Centralizes Android application identity, custom URL scheme, notification channel labels, reply prompts, action feedback, and mute or reminder status text.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes Android positional string placeholders for buddy reply and sent-message templates.

nodes.name: styles.xml
nodes.summary: Defines the base, no-action-bar, and splash themes for the native Android shell, including system bar appearance, brand background colors, and launch drawables.
nodes.languageNotes: AppCompat and Android SplashScreen theme inheritance separates normal activity styling from launch-time presentation.
